question: How is the divine lotus of the first octad described in meditation?
premises: The lotus has eight spokes or petals in structure.
It is adorned by the first octad.
inference: The meditation presents a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āraṃ may suggest spokes rather than petals depending on imagery.
plain_english: Meditate on a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
